entities.name: Yamada Nagamasa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yamada Nagamasa or Ok-ya Senaphimuk was a Japanese adventurer who gained considerable influence in the Ayutthaya Kingdom at the beginning of the 17th century and became the governor of Nakhon Si Thammarat, which is on the Malay Peninsula in present-day Southern Thailand.
